one_line: A Pala-era Vikramashila scribe and his Tibetan monk-collaborator carrying Prajnaparamita manuscripts across the Himalayas.

appearance.age_look: mid-20s and early-30s, lean scholarly builds
appearance.face: Vidyakar has an oval face, medium-brown complexion and a calm, sharp-gazed default expression with slightly arched brows; Tenzin has a broader face, fairer coppery complexion, high cheekbones and a serene, empathetic smile.
appearance.hair: Vidyakar’s straight black hair is shoulder-length, centre-parted and neatly tied back with a narrow red cord; Tenzin’s black hair is mostly shaved in monk fashion with a very short dark stubble and no headwear.
appearance.costume: Vidyakar wears a finely woven, cream-coloured cotton uttariya draped over both shoulders and wrapped snugly around his torso, paired with a deep indigo ankle-length dhoti with a narrow red border, a simple brown leather belt pouch, and a thin copper necklace with a small leaf-shaped pendant; his feet are in plain dark-brown leather sandals, and his right forearm bears three slim red and yellow thread bangles; Tenzin wears a maroon woollen chuba-style outer robe over a saffron-yellow inner shirt, the chuba crossing left over right and tied with a hidden sash, with the hem reaching mid-calf, layered over dark rust-red trousers and soft dark-brown felt boots, plus a simple dark-maroon wool shawl folded over his left shoulder.
appearance.signature: Vidyakar carries a long dark-brown palm-leaf manuscript bundle wrapped in a pale ochre cloth with red tie-cords and wooden cover-boards, while Tenzin supports it from below with both hands, a fine wooden stylus tucked at its edge.

ref_desc: Vidyakar is a medium-brown, sharp-gazed Pala scribe with shoulder-length tied-back black hair, cream uttariya and deep indigo dhoti, beside Tenzin, a fair coppery Tibetan monk with shaved stubble, maroon chuba, saffron shirt, dark trousers and boots, jointly carrying a wrapped palm-leaf manuscript bundle with wooden covers in cream, indigo, maroon, saffron and dark-brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of two characters standing side by side: Vidyakar, a medium-brown Pala-era scribe with an oval face and calm sharp eyes, straight black hair to the shoulders neatly tied back with a red cord, wearing a cream cotton uttariya draped over both shoulders and wrapped around his torso, a deep indigo ankle-length dhoti with a narrow red border, thin copper necklace with a small leaf pendant, three slim red and yellow thread bangles on his right forearm, a simple brown leather belt pouch and dark-brown leather sandals; and Tenzin, a Tibetan monk with a broader face, fair coppery skin, high cheekbones and a serene smile, his black hair shaved to very short stubble, wearing a maroon wool chuba-style outer robe crossing left over right to mid-calf over a saffron-yellow inner shirt, dark rust-red trousers, soft dark-brown felt boots and a dark-maroon wool shawl folded over his left shoulder; have them jointly carry a long dark-brown palm-leaf manuscript bundle wrapped in pale ochre cloth with red tie-cords and flat wooden cover-boards, with a fine wooden stylus tucked at its edge, and keep the dominant colours cream, deep indigo, maroon, saffron yellow and dark brown.
